limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not been run.
implementation: Eight uninitialized flip-flops shift S into Q[0] on enabled positive clock edges; combinational selection uses ABC as the Q index.
testbench: Independent per-bit storage oracle checks startup unknowns, partial and complete MSB-first loads, all addresses, disabled holds, data changes without edges, falling edges, all-zero/all-one loads, and mixed enabled cycles.
